products.reason_for_recall: Ahold U.S.A., Inc. was notified by the Virginia Department of Agriculture that one of three retail samples of Whole Kernel Corn, 16 oz. tested positive for Listeria Monocytogenes on 11/13/2017. The firm has decided to initiate a recall of the product .
